description: Find, install and remove the browsers Extension.js tooling can launch. Pass action:'detect' (the default) to scan both system-installed and managed browsers, and report each one's binary path, version, engine and debugger support. Pass action:'list' for the managed cache this tool downloads into, with each binary's version and size on disk. Both report the version the binary itself carries (its bundle metadata, else --version), prerelease suffix included (159.0a1), never the cache folder's name. Pass action:'install' to download a managed binary: several hundred MB in one blocking call, so allow a generous client timeout. Pass action:'uninstall' to remove managed binaries; it never touches a system install.

browser.description: install/uninstall: which managed binary. Required for install.

browsers.description: detect: limit the scan to these. Omit to check all.

name: extension_browsers
